sources.entry: Rossum.ai - Automated business transaction document platform. #free

summary.name: Rossum
summary.one_liner: Rossum is an AI document processing platform whose agents capture, validate, and transform transactional documents and push the data into ERP systems.
use_cases: automate invoice processing in accounts payable
extract data from invoices and transactional documents
route documents for approval with auto-approve rules
send automated vendor notification emails for exceptions
write validated data into an ERP
summary.what_it_does: The page describes AI agents that ingest documents from email, scanners, PEPPOL, and shared drives, then read and extract data using a proprietary transactional LLM that it says supports 276 languages and handwriting. Extracted data is cross-validated against master data, ERPs, and third-party APIs, and missing fields such as GL codes, tax codes, and HS codes are inferred. Rules can auto-approve or reject documents, and the agents can send vendor emails. The platform also offers metrics on turnaround time and straight-through processing rate, a full audit trail per document, and search across extracted and non-extracted data. Most figures on the page are customer case studies (for example Wolt, Morton Salt, Adyen) rather than independent benchmarks.
notable: Proprietary transactional LLM that learns from user feedback, claimed to support 276 languages and handwriting
Integrates with downstream ERPs and supports PEPPOL e-invoicing ingestion
Rules-based auto-approve/reject and AI-generated vendor emails
Per-document audit trail and search across extracted and non-extracted data
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Performance figures come from vendor-selected customer case studies
